revision_change: Move yaw/pitch fulcrum to bite height420mm; add bolted double3mm aluminium offset plates with twoM4 bolts and crush sleeves, keeping the exact R3 angled front geometry and mouth clearance.

steel.grade_target: corrosion-protected structural steel fork and pins; purchase specification pending

stainless.grade_target: 304 bite core, sealed and food-contact review pending

polyurethane.grade_target: wheel and bite sleeve; compound, hardness and food-contact qualification pending

procurement: No OEM SKU chosen. Castor/fork/bearing/brake solids are engineering interface envelopes and custom fabrication candidates, not downloaded vendor CAD. Selected bought wheel module must meet dimensions and mass before design freeze.
assumptions: One 600x400 mm tote or boxed goods, cargo COM restricted near deck center.
Smooth indoor supermarket floor; no powered cart drive or robot docking latch.
Two front swivel wheels and two rear fixed wheels, rear manual parking brakes.
Yaw, pitch and axial roll joints are cart hardware; no added robot joint or object binding.
Pitch spring must balance drawbar self-weight; no automatic hold-position assumption.
grip_height_adjustment_note: At the nominal free-pitch configuration, carriage and sleeve center heights are both400/420/440mm. Front shaft manufactured offset/angle10deg is built in; only420mm has the current prescribed GooseFK check.
grip_center_definition: Actual sleeve center is retained from R3. The free pitch fulcrum and yaw fulcrum are now at the same nominal height420mm, removing extra horizontal-force pitch torque. Front shaft remains inclined10deg via a real offset bracket, not via applied spring torque.
